import pandas as pd

# List of source file paths as given
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/training_9.csv"
]

# Note: Source4 (training_4.csv) is NOT included in the UNION operation as per operation_history.

# Read all source CSV files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and types:
    # Target schema: ['admit': int, 'gre': int, 'gpa': float, 'prestige': int]
    # Convert columns to correct types explicitly
    df = df[['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']]  # select columns explicitly to ensure order
    df['admit'] = df['admit'].astype(int)
    df['gre'] = df['gre'].astype(int)
    df['gpa'] = df['gpa'].astype(float)
    df['prestige'] = df['prestige'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Perform UNION (concatenation) of all source DataFrames
Target9_98 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the resulting DataFrame to the target CSV file
Target9_98.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_98/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
